newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks closed lower on Wednesday with small retail investors, who were largely responsible for taking the index up from the 550 point level to past 600, selling to take profits, brokers said.
The Colombo Stock Exchange all share index closed 5.4 points lower at 601.3. Hatton National Bank rose five rupees to 215 rupees, John Keells rose 2.25 to 182.25.

The index closed lower due to the "continuing cycle of profit taking, and since many did not know how to react to the Rehabilitation of Public Enterprise bill, passed in parliament on Tuesday," said Sarinda Unamboowe of brokerage John Keells.
